hypothesis: Qualifying surface_uv centroid fixed the detail guard and cost water_reflection 2.4 percent of its display stability, and narrowing the qualifier to surface_uv alone changed neither number, so the whole effect is in that one varying. A centroid varying is sampled wherever the covered samples happen to sit, which differs between neighbouring pixels and between frames, so its screen derivatives jump — and those derivatives set the facade's antialias width and the footprint average's whole extent. Carrying the same coordinate twice, centroid for the value and smooth for the derivatives, should keep the correct cell without the jitter.

provenance.origin: V2-3i, after msaa_4x_centroid and msaa_4x_centroid_surface_uv were both rejected on water_reflection alone
provenance.note: The two earlier candidates scored 0.8773 and 0.8777 display excess flicker on water_reflection against a shipped 0.8569, and identical guard distances, which is what says the varying rather than its breadth is responsible.
